klaim.bukti: The same ID was maintained for grape bunches seen from different perspectives to enhance Object Tracking.
klaim.catatan: Anotasi MOTS pada 11 video UAV; delapan video multi-sudut mempertahankan ID tandan anggur yang sama lintas perspektif.

yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar API (abstrak kosong); WebSearch gagal karena kuota sesi habis; WebFetch halaman artikel iieta.org berhasil

klaim.bukti: [parafrasa web] Hungarian Matching ensures that detected bounding boxes in the left image are accurately associated with their corresponding detections in the right image; 3D coordinates follow from stereo triangulation of loose oil palm fruits detected by YOLOv8.
klaim.catatan: Pencocokan Hungarian dipakai antara citra kiri dan kanan pasangan stereo, bukan antarsisi pohon; sesuai dengan kalimat naskah. Nomor halaman tidak diperiksa karena sumber berupa halaman web.

klaim.bukti: we put forward a prediction-driven two-stage matching strategy based on ByteTrack, which effectively reduces duplicate counting caused by missed detections
klaim.catatan: Prediksi lintasan (enkoder KAN, dekoder Mamba) untuk melengkapi lintasan bluberi di rumah kaca; abstrak tidak memakai kata video secara eksplisit, tetapi pelacakan antarbingkai tersirat.

klaim.bukti: Compared with the faster R-CNN detector of RGB-D images, the recall, the precision and F1-score of MS-FRCNN method increased from 0.922 to 0.962, 0.850 to 0.931 and 0.885 to 0.946, respectively.
klaim.catatan: Detektor RGB dan depth dilatih terpisah lalu digabung dengan late fusion; angka F1 0,885 dan 0,946 cocok.

klaim.bukti: Our calibration and validation datasets each consist of over 28,000 colour images of over 1000 experimental plants. [...] our proposed method achieves a correlation of 74.2% without any linear adjustment for a large dataset.
klaim.catatan: Angka cocok. Catatan: lebih dari 28.000 citra itu berlaku untuk masing-masing set kalibrasi dan validasi, bukan jumlah keseluruhan.

klaim.bukti: the former was found to be more reliable compared to the ROI-line method in counting the pears, as characterized by its F1count of 87.85%. [...] due to flickering in detection it was not able to count some pears despite their being detected.
klaim.catatan: F1count 87,85% (ID unik) terhadap 72,94% (garis ROI) pada Tabel 9; alasan kedipan deteksi dinyatakan di abstrak dan simpulan.
